section.-

14. Incentives to foreign
investors, etc.-(1) Where, under agreement or treaty with Government of
Pakistan. any foreign company makes any investment in any industrial
undertaking or a class of industrial undertakings within an Industrial Zone set
up for such industrial undertakings the Federal Government may by notification
in the official Gazette allow such exemption from payment of any tax duty or
surcharge to such industrial undertaking or class of undertakings as may
specified in the notification.
(2) Where a notification under
sub-section (1) is issued the provisions of the Industrial Relations Ordinance.
1969 (XXII of 1969) and such other laws as the Federal Government may. by
notification in the official Gazette. specify shall not apply to the Industrial
undertaking or class of undertakings situated in the Industrial Zones specified
in such notification.
(3) The Federal Government may
make rules for carrying out the purposes of sub-section (1) and sub-section
(2).

15. Federal Education Fee:--(1)
There shall be levied and collected Federal Education Fee from every company as
defined in the Companies Ordinance. 1984 (XLVII of 1984) whose fixed assets its
shown in its balance sheet made on or after the thirtieth day of June. 1992.
are valued at more than fifty million rupees at such rate and in such manner and
front such date as may be specified in a scheme notified by the Federal
Government in the official Gazette.
(2) No fee under subsection (1)
shall be payable by a company specified in column (1) of the table below, if it
has set up or sets up, manages and runs educational institution specified in
column (2) of that table within such period as may be notified in the scheme
referred to in subsection (1).
